papers.title: Effects of laser processing parameters on thermal behavior and melting/solidification mechanism during selective laser melting of TiC/Inconel 718 composites
papers.first_author_affiliation: College of Materials Science and Technology, Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, Yudao Street 29, Nanjing 210016, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究TiC/Inconel 718复合材料的选择性激光熔化工艺参数，与生物医学植入物的应力屏蔽、多孔结构或骨整合无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on laser processing of TiC/Inconel 718 composites for non-biomedical applications; it does not address porous structure, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光参数对TiC/Inconel 718复合材料熔凝行为的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验与数值模拟结合，分析激光功率、扫描速度等参数对热行为和熔凝机制的作用。
summary_zh.result: 发现参数显著影响熔池形态和微观组织，优化参数可减少缺陷。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验观察与模拟对比验证模型准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of laser processing parameters on the thermal behavior and melting/solidification mechanism of TiC/Inconel 718 composites during selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: A combined experimental and numerical simulation approach was used to analyze the effects of laser power, scanning speed, and other parameters on melt pool dynamics and solidification microstructure.
summary_en.result: Processing parameters significantly affect melt pool morphology and resulting microstructure; optimized parameters reduce defects such as pores and cracks.
summary_en.validation: Experimental observations of melt pool geometry and microstructure were compared with simulation results to validate the model.
